newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE euroyen boosted by weak BOJ economic report.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE euroyen boosted by weak BOJ economic report.

text.p: The key March three-month euroyen futures contract extended gains in late afternoon trade on Thursday due to release of the Bank of Japan's quarterly economic report which contained a weak economic outlook.
"The BOJ seems to have toned down its economic outlook," said a trader for a foreign brokerage house.
The March stood at 99.08 as of 0611 GMT, up from Wednesday's settlement of 99.06, which is where the March had stood just moments before the release of the BOJ report.
The March was also boosted by a surge in Japanese government bonds, a trader for a major brokerage house said.

The economic recovery is unlikely to gather significant momentum in view of the fragility in some sectors as well as continued pressure from balance sheet adjustments, the BOJ said in its quarterly economic report on Thursday.
